transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I’ve been feeling kind of foggy. I keep mixing up simple things, like appointment times or dates for exhibits, and I can’t always remember which volunteer I already called. It’s been bothering me.
Have these memory problems been getting worse over time?
I don’t know if I’d say worse exactly… it’s just been noticeable. My head feels foggy, and I keep getting small things mixed up—appointments, exhibit dates, who I already called.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?
I’m… not sure I’d call it depressed. I’ve been a bit low maybe, but mostly just foggy and frustrated.
Have you been enjoying your usual activities less than you used to?
Yeah… I guess so. My watercolors, the tomato plants, even watching the cardinals out back… I used to enjoy those things. Lately they just sort of sit there, and I can’t seem to care much.
Have you been feeling down or sad most days?
Some days, maybe. I wouldn’t say most days… I just feel kind of flat, I suppose.
Do these memory problems make it hard for you to manage your daily tasks on your own?

Yes… more than I’d like to admit. I’ve missed some doctor visits, and I got the senior center schedule all mixed up. My husband’s had to help with the calls and calendars… and even decisions about repairs that I used to handle myself.
During the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless nearly every day?
I don’t think nearly every day, no. I’ve had some low spells, but… I wouldn’t put it quite that strongly.
Since this first started, has your memory been steadily getting worse?

It does feel like it’s been getting worse… or at least more noticeable. My head’s been foggy, and I keep mixing up simple things—appointment times, dates for exhibits, even which volunteer I already called.
How has your sleep been lately?
It’s… hard to say. Some nights are better than others, I suppose. I haven’t really been keeping track.
Have you been feeling nervous or worried a lot lately?
I don’t know… I worry some, I suppose. But I’m not sure I’d say a lot.
Have you had trouble managing your finances, like paying bills or balancing the checkbook?
Not really the checkbook, no… I haven’t noticed that so much. It’s more that my head feels foggy and I mix up simple things, like times for appointments or dates I’m supposed to remember.
Have you had any weakness on one side of your body?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed one side being weaker than the other.
Have you been feeling unusually sensitive to cold lately?
No… I don’t think I’ve noticed being colder than usual.
Do you need help with dressing or bathing?
No… I can dress and bathe myself. It’s more other things lately—appointments, schedules. My husband’s had to help with calls and calendars more than I like.
Have you been having trouble finding the right words when you speak?
Not really… I mean, sometimes I pause, but I haven’t noticed not being able to find words much.
Do you need help managing your medications?
I… I’m not sure. I take them, but sometimes my husband helps me keep track.
Has a doctor told you that you have a medical condition affecting your brain or memory?
Not that I know of… no one’s told me that directly.
Over the past two weeks, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy nearly every day?
Yes… nearly every day, I guess. Things I used to love—my watercolors, the tomato plants, even watching the cardinals out back—I just… can’t seem to care about them right now.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling tired or low on energy nearly every day?
Yes… most days. I wake up tired even if I slept, and after I wash up and make breakfast, I feel like I need to sit down again.
Has a doctor ever told you that you have a brain condition, such as a stroke, Parkinson’s disease, or a head injury?
No… I don’t believe anyone’s ever told me I had anything like that.
